verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that a self-managed edition exists: it references Bitbucket Server and Data Center licenses, but in the context of migrating users off them to Cloud. Nothing describes installing or configuring a self-managed instance, or how easy that is. Missing for 10: installation documentation, evidence of low-effort setup (e.g. packaged installers, containers, defaults), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
